teamPage.title: Team
teamPage.subtitle: Invite people into your organization and choose the role each of them receives.
teamPage.inviteHelp: Generate an invite link, pick the role the invitee is granted, and share the link. Signing in with it makes them a member of your organization.
teamPage.roleDesc: The role the invitee receives on joining. Shape what each role can do in Security → Roles.
